description: Deployment configuration for mod-finance-storage (ADR-0013). Default values are calibrated against a reference bugfest environment (tebfcon-mod-finance-storage revision 15).

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the mod-finance container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the mod-finance container in MiB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the mod-finance container in MiB

java.name: MetaspaceSize
java.description: Initial Java metaspace size, threshold at which the first metaspace garbage collection runs (-XX:MetaspaceSize)

deployment.description: The only in-memory state is the settings cache (Caffeine, 30 s expiry by default), which each instance refreshes on its own. The audit outbox reader selects rows with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, so concurrent instances do not publish the same event twice.

kong.description: Kong route timeouts in milliseconds for mod-organizations.

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database host

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database port

EnvVars.name: DB_USERNAME
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database user. Deployed from the secret store

EnvVars.name: DB_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for DB_USERNAME user. Deployed from the secret store.

EnvVars.name: DB_DATABASE
EnvVars.description: Database name that holds the per-tenant schemas.

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST_READER
EnvVars.description: Optional read-replica host for read queries; used only together with DB_PORT_READER

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT_READER
EnvVars.description: Port of the read replica set in DB_HOST_READER

EnvVars.name: DB_SERVER_PEM
EnvVars.description: PEM certificate of the PostgreSQL server; when set, connections use TLSv1.3 with full verification

EnvVars.name: DB_MAXPOOLSIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum connections per tenant pool. Value taken from bugfest; RMB default is 4

EnvVars.name: DB_MAXSHAREDPOOLSIZE
EnvVars.description: When set, all tenants share one pool of this size instead of per-tenant pools of DB_MAXPOOLSIZE

EnvVars.name: DB_CONNECTIONRELEASEDELAY
EnvVars.description: Idle time in milliseconds before a pooled connection is closed (RMB default)

EnvVars.name: DB_MAX_LIFETIME
EnvVars.description: Maximum lifetime of a pooled connection in milliseconds (RMB default)

EnvVars.name: DB_RECONNECTATTEMPTS
EnvVars.description: Number of reconnect attempts when a database connection cannot be established (Vert.x default 0)

EnvVars.name: DB_RECONNECTINTERVAL
EnvVars.description: Interval in milliseconds between database reconnect attempts (Vert.x default)

EnvVars.name: DB_EXPLAIN_QUERY_THRESHOLD
EnvVars.description: Queries slower than this many milliseconds are logged with EXPLAIN ANALYZE. Value taken from bugfest; RMB default is 1000

EnvVars.name: DB_ALLOW_SUPPRESS_OPTIMISTIC_LOCKING
EnvVars.description: ISO-8601 timestamp until which clients may bypass optimistic locking (_version) on purchase orders, order lines and pieces; unset means never

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_HOST
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker host used to publish fund and budget audit events (ACQ_FUND_CHANGED, ACQ_BUDGET_CHANGED). 'kafka' is the code and README default for local development. Not present on the module container in the tebfcon reference revision 15, which predates the audit events; the 9.0.0 module needs it set there.

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_PORT
EnvVars.description: Kafka broker port for KAFKA_HOST. Same deployment note as KAFKA_HOST

EnvVars.name: REPLICATION_FACTOR
EnvVars.description: Replication factor applied to Kafka topics the module creates

EnvVars.name: MAX_REQUEST_SIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum size in bytes of a produced Kafka record

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Environment name. It prefixes Kafka topic names and prefixes the secret-store key for tenant exchange-rate credentials

EnvVars.name: OKAPI_URL
EnvVars.description: Gateway URL

EnvVars.name: KAFKA_PRODUCER_TENANT_COLLECTION
EnvVars.description: This enables messages to be produced to a tenants consolidated topic. It must match [A-Z][A-Z0-9]{0,30}.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Secret store that holds per-tenant exchange-rate API key and secret. Supported values: EPHEMERAL, AWS_SSM, VAULT, FSSP. Default is EPHEMERAL

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_REGION
EnvVars.description: Required when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=AWS_SSM. Region of the AWS SSM Parameter Store that holds the secrets

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_USE_IAM
EnvVars.description: When true the SSM client uses the task's IAM role. When false it uses the ECS credentials endpoint set in SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_ECS_CREDENTIALS_ENDPOINT. Applies to AWS_SSM only.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_ECS_CREDENTIALS_ENDPOINT
EnvVars.description: HTTP endpoint for retrieving AWS credentials. Ignored when SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_USE_IAM is true. Applies to AWS_SSM only.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_ECS_CREDENTIALS_PATH
EnvVars.description: Path appended to SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_ECS_CREDENTIALS_ENDPOINT to form the credentials URI. Ignored when SECRET_STORE_AWS_SSM_USE_IAM is true. Applies to AWS_SSM only.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_TOKEN
EnvVars.description: Token used to authenticate to Vault. Required when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=VAULT

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_ADDRESS
EnvVars.description: Vault server address. Required when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=VAULT

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_ENABLE_SSL
EnvVars.description: Whether to use SSL when connecting to Vault. When true, the PEM, keystore and truststore variables below supply the certificates. Applies to VAULT only.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_PEM_FILE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Path to an unencrypted PEM X.509 certificate (UTF-8) for verifying Vault. Applies to VAULT with SSL enabled.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the JKS keystore at SECRET_STORE_VAULT_KEYSTORE_FILE_PATH. Optional. Applies to VAULT only.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_KEYSTORE_FILE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Path to a JKS keystore holding the client certificate and private key for Vault. Applies to VAULT only.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_VAULT_TRUSTSTORE_FILE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Path to a JKS truststore holding the Vault server certificates to trust. Applies to VAULT only.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_ADDRESS
EnvVars.description: Address (URL) of the FOLIO Secure Store Proxy. Required when SECRET_STORE_TYPE=FSSP; startup fails without it. Note that exchange-rate credentials are not stored through FSSP in this module (see SECRET_STORE_TYPE).

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_SECRET_PATH
EnvVars.description: Path in FSSP where secrets are stored. The value is the documented README default.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_KEYSTORE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Path to the key store file used for client authentication to FSSP. Applies to FSSP only.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_KEYSTORE_FILE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Type of the FSSP key store file, for example jks or pem. Applies to FSSP only.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the FSSP key store file. Inject from a secret. Applies to FSSP only.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_TRUSTSTORE_PATH
EnvVars.description: Path to the trust store file used to verify the FSSP server. Applies to FSSP only.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_TRUSTSTORE_FILE_TYPE
EnvVars.description: Type of the FSSP trust store file, for example JKS or PKCS12. Applies to FSSP only.

EnvVars.name: SECRET_STORE_FSSP_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: Password for the FSSP trust store file. Inject from a secret. Applies to FSSP only.

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTIONS
EnvVars.description: JVM flags read by run-java.sh in the folioci/alpine-jre-openjdk21 base image named in the Dockerfile. The default is the value in the module's launch descriptor and gives about 676 MiB of heap in a 1024 MiB container, close to the 700m in the java block. The tebfcon reference sets JAVA_OPTS instead; per the ADR-0013 notes this entrypoint does not read JAVA_OPTS, so the heap there would be the JVM default of 25% of the container. That was not verified against the image here and should be raised with the hosting team. The same variable also carries -Dhttp.port: the RMB default port is 8081 and the reference moves the module to 8082 because the sidecar owns 8081.

EnvVars.name: LOG4J_CONFIGURATION_FILE
EnvVars.description: Location (file path or URL) of an external Log4j2 configuration. Read by Log4j2 itself and used instead of the bundled log4j2.properties. The tebfcon reference points it at an S3-hosted file. Unset uses the bundled configuration.

EnvVars.name: FINANCE_STORAGE_CACHE_SETTINGS_EXPIRATION_TIME_SECONDS
EnvVars.description: Seconds a cached tenant setting is served before it is reloaded. This is the Spring property finance.storage.cache.settings.expiration.time.seconds, which Spring also resolves from this environment-variable form. A change made through the settings endpoint on one instance becomes visible on the other instances only after this time.

EnvVars.name: loadReference
EnvVars.description: Environment variable name is lowercase camelCase, exactly as the code reads it (TenantReferenceAPI). Sets the default for loading reference data when a tenant is enabled; a loadReference parameter on the tenant request overrides it. Left false because reference data is loaded on request.

EnvVars.name: loadSample
EnvVars.description: Environment variable name is lowercase camelCase, exactly as the code reads it (TenantReferenceAPI). Sets the default for loading sample data when a tenant is enabled; a loadSample parameter on the tenant request overrides it. Keep false outside demo and test environments.

resources.description: CPU request/limit for the sidecar container

resources.name: memory

resources.description: Memory reservation for the sidecar container, in MB

java.name: UseZGC

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTS
EnvVars.description: Additional JVM options for the sidecar process

EnvVars.name: MODULE_NAME
EnvVars.description: Name of the module this sidecar fronts

EnvVars.name: MODULE_URL
EnvVars.description: Internal URL (host:port) at which the mod-finance backend container is reachable from its sidecar

EnvVars.name: MODULE_VERSION
EnvVars.description: Version of the mod-finance module deployed alongside this sidecar
